spec.curve_basis: Manufacturer stabilized-voltage sweep with small r=6 mm inlet lip, at 21 C and 50 m ASL. Linear interpolation only inside supplied data. Power versus thrust is an equivalent-operating-point estimate, not a fixed-6S partial-throttle curve. No extrapolation below the first point.
spec.yaw_gate: These fixed EDF products have no documented matched reverse-rotation assemblies or installed net reaction-torque curve in the cited data. Stator-equipped aircraft in the cited study use deflecting vanes; applicability, actuator dynamics, loss and mounting envelope must be designed here.
